name: My Zypp Stikks 28 Pack x 1g Prerolls - Trop Cherry
description:
Twenty-eight joints, one jar. The My Zypp Stikks Trop Cherry 28-pack gives you twenty-eight full-gram pre-rolls — 28 grams total — rolled and ready to smoke, packed in a sealed jar that keeps them fresh. No grinding, no rolling, no running out.

Trop Cherry brings a bright, tropical-meets-fruit profile: sweet dark cherry up front with juicy citrus brightness and a smooth, subtly earthy finish.

28 × 1G pre-rolls — 28 grams total, serious value in one jar
Jar packaging — keeps every joint fresh and protected
Ready to smoke — no grinding, no rolling, no setup
Signature Trop Cherry flavor — sweet cherry with juicy citrus and an earthy finish

My Zypp Stikks Trop Cherry is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
